sentence_markdown: During my [walk] in a park, I saw a squirrel.

classifierNotes: Less is more is treated as an aphorism rather than a proverb because it states a maxim without narrative proverb form.
Definately is a typo of definitely; mark only `member.orthography: "Typo"` here, not a spelling variant, because the intended resolved surface is canonical.
Them is an accusative surface of they; singular-they readings are not separately encoded.
Complementizer that is SCONJ; no clause-type feature exists, so POS carries the distinction.
Saw is the past finite surface of see, not the citation noun saw.

sentence_markdown: If I [were] you, I would wait.
classifierNotes: Were in if I were you is AUX with Mood=Sub; the schema allows mood without forcing person or number.

The Full Attestation records spilled, the, and beans as the complete idiom occurrence; the docs review span remains on spilled only.
That before a noun is DET, distinct from pronominal and complementizer that.

sentence_markdown: [My bad], I merged the wrong branch.
classifierNotes: My bad is categorized by discourse function Apology, not by the adjective bad.

classifierNotes: The Full Attestation records every member of the proverb occurrence; the docs review span remains on the salient fragment early bird.
Gerund running is a VERB inflection, not a noun, despite occupying a nominal clause position.
Only See is selected, but the intended formula is see you later.

Clicking the particle resolves the complete phrasal-verb occurrence `gave up`; the click is one member of that Surface.

Bio is modeled as a bound root in bioreactor, not as a free clipping of biography.

The suffix citation includes a leading hyphen, while the attested substring omits it.
Voice=Pass is context-sensitive for English participles; it is included to test whether the model accepts contextual morphology.

classifierNotes: The verb is inflected in the sentence, while the idiom resolves to a Citation Surface linked to its Phraseme Lemma.

classifierNotes: Only the verb component is selected, but the Lemma and surface are the phrasal verb take off.

Family-name plural is PROPN with inflectional number rather than a common noun.
The hyphenated ordinal modifying a noun is ADJ with ordinal number features.
Wind as weather is a noun citation surface sharing spelling with the verb wind.
Scissors uses Number=Ptan to stress plurale-tantum support.
They is marked plural because the current English PRON schema has number but no singular-they semantic flag.

Half before a noun phrase is DET with fractional number features, not NUM.
